proposals.title: Shareholder proposal to adopt a policy for an independent board chair
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt a policy and amend bylaws requiring the Board Chair to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that shareholders vote Against the shareholder proposal to adopt a policy for an independent board chair.

proposals.title: Shareholder proposal requesting animal pain management reporting
proposals.proponent: The Humane Society of the United States
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Target to disclose progress on its animal pain management commitment, including procedures, supply chain percentages, and pain management provided.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that shareholders vote Against the shareholder proposal requesting animal pain management reporting.

proposals.title: Shareholder proposal to establish wage policies
proposals.proponent: The Shareholder Commons, on behalf of Legal & General Investment Management America, Inc.
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to establish wage policies providing workers minimum earnings to meet families' basic needs, consistent with a living wage.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that shareholders vote Against the shareholder proposal to establish wage policies.

proposals.title: Shareholder proposal requesting a political contributions congruency analysis
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Target to annually report on political and electioneering expenditures and any incongruence with stated company values and policies.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that shareholders vote Against the shareholder proposal requesting a political contributions congruency analysis.

proposals.title: Shareholder proposal requesting a report on Target's partnerships with, charitable contributions to, and other support for certain organizations
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to evaluate and report on risks to financial sustainability and reputation from partnerships and donations to divisive social and political organizations, such as HRC's Corporate Equality Index.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that shareholders vote Against the shareholder proposal requesting a report on Target's partnerships with, charitable contributions to, and other support for certain organizations.
